question: Pinjore heritage festival is organised by the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pinjore Heritage Festival** is organized by the state of **Haryana**.
 
• It is celebrated at the **Pinjore Gardens**, also known as **Yadavindra Gardens**, which is a historic 17th-century garden.
 
• The festival showcases the rich cultural heritage of Haryana through various cultural performances, crafts, and food stalls.
 
• The event aims to promote tourism and preserve the traditional arts and crafts of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Pinjore Gardens** were built by the Mughal governor** Fidai Khan** in the 17th century and are an excellent example of Mughal garden architecture.
 
• Haryana Tourism organizes the festival annually to highlight the state's history, culture, and traditions.
 
• The festival also includes various competitions, folk dances, musical performances, and traditional games.
 
• The event provides a platform for local artisans and craftsmen to display and sell their products, contributing to the local economy.
